paragraphs.text: Kakkazan was a spirit of Kamigawa .

Kakkazan took the shape of an upright crocodile with ruby-colored scales. Eight massively-muscled arms stretched from its body. It carried a tetsubo into battle. Disembodied mouths, translucent, with orange lips, floated about it. Kakkazan also controlled three other kami , the Kami of Ash, Searing Wind, and Black Glass. These spirits resembled three-legged spiders , the Kami of Ash supporting the body of a grey, old man, Searing Wind a lidless orange eye , and Black Glass a featureless head.
Kakkazan climbed Ryusaki Kumano 's plateau in search of the yamabushi 's rumored secret but was defeated.
